lessons.text: Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Rosalind Franklin.
Never use ad hominem (Attacking the arguer instead of the argument). It cost you against Rosalind Franklin.
Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against Rosalind Franklin.
